value.rationale: It is a complete, parameter-free additive criterion for adaptive online complexity across all four-point cyclic translation systems, including periodic and aperiodic cases. It detects a nonobvious structural dichotomy missed by hypothesis number and support size: for every n>=15, cyclic Sidon four-sets have rank two while four consecutive points have rank three, both with n hypotheses. The exact autocorrelation-to-mistake-tree bridge is motivated by cyclic difference patterns and gives a reusable small-support learning invariant.
